delivery_checks: One frame of a three-frame Story (hook, proof, action), built in Canva only from the piece's approved assets; Story artwork itself stays content-engine's.
One frame per post, in order; no invented interactive controls, illustration boilerplate or link-sticker claim.
Keep paired Meta outputs deduplicated; verify feed delivery before the Story runs.
Share mechanic: the hook frame works with no context, so a person sends the Story to one specific person in a private message; the share block names that person as its receiver.
Before Krish sees it: a complete share block (social/share.json), no generic share call to action in the copy, and a blind send test whose reader names the declared receiver and job (crew/send-test).
After a save, wait and independently reopen; reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying.
measurements: Primary measure (Krish, 28 October 2026): sends, meaning native shares, per reach and saves per reach against the format's own channel median; a house hypothesis until MYMU's own dated data confirms it (lesson share-rate-measure).
Exposed first/last-frame reach, exits, replies and continuation taps; preserve unavailable values.
Compare relevant follower and attributable subscriber movement after actual delivery.
